title: 第二十六章   女神榜
content_zh:
“女神榜啊，这个貌似有点含金量啊！”琼霄双眼迷离的想象着。

    “咦，你都有蓝湘学姐了，还不够啊，还想着拈花惹草啊，小心蓝湘学姐阉了你！”李朗恶狠狠的威胁道。

    “额额，”琼霄被这李朗突如其来的话下了一跳，后背突然一凉，双腿紧绷着。以蓝湘的性格来说，这有可能！这使得琼霄不禁打了个冷颤。

    “别胡说，我是那种人么？”琼霄不好意思的辩解道。

    “咦…典型的妻管严就说，还不是那种人，你那点花花肠子，我还不知道？”李朗露出了那鄙夷的眼神。

    “咳咳！赶紧让我看看，这女神榜都有些什么人？”被李朗用那鄙夷的眼神盯着，琼霄赶紧转移话题。

    “嘿嘿，就知道你会迫不及待的想知道上面有些什么女生吧？”

    “嘿嘿，”琼霄挠了挠头，强装着说严肃的表情说道：“哪里，我只是想看看我心爱的湘儿在这里被如何评价的！”

    “额……”李朗把卷轴给了琼霄，他实在是服了琼霄了！再不把卷轴给他，他迟早会被琼霄气死。

    随着卷轴的打开，那卷轴之中飘出了一种清香，这卷轴出自女生之手！琼霄露出了一丝邪恶的笑容盯着李朗，道：“你小子不够仗义啊，来到星辰学院才短短几天，你就勾搭上了女生，还不告诉我！”

    “额，你胡说八道，我哪里勾搭上女生了！”李朗大喊道，泡沫顿时满天飞舞。

    琼霄尽力的躲着，赶忙说道：“咳咳，别激动，有事好好说！”

    “好好，我让你好好说，今天要不说出个所以然来，看我怎么整你！”

    “我这是有根据的，又不是乱说的好不好！你刚才拿的卷轴中散发着一种清香，这肯定是女生的东西！”琼霄举着卷轴，道。

    哐当！李朗一头砸在了床榻上，“你，你小子就是因为这清香就说我在外面勾搭女孩子，我，我怎么跟，跟你这蠢货同住一间宿舍！”李朗被琼霄这话给雷到了。

    “额……那这卷轴上怎么会有女生才有的清香？”琼霄不死心的问道。

    “那卷轴是出自一个女生团体，那是她们精心制作的，怎么可能会没有这种清香？”李朗翻了翻白眼，道。

    “好吧！那是我错怪你了，以后有啥美事，要叫上我，饱饱眼福也行啊！”

    “切，你不怕蓝湘学姐，我还怕咧，带你去玩，被她发现，那还不得把我打个半死！想玩啊你自己去，”李朗淡淡的道。

    “我俩还是不是兄弟！”
content_en:
"Goddess list, this seems to be a bit valuable!" Qiong Xiao imagined with blurred eyes.

"Hey, you already have Senior Lan Xiang, and that's not enough. You're still thinking of flirting with women. Be careful that Senior Lan Xiang castrates you!" Li Lang threatened viciously.

"Uh-huh," Qiong Xiao was jumped by Li Lang's sudden words. A sudden chill ran down her back and her legs became tense.Considering Lan Xiang's character, this is possible!This made Qiong Xiao shiver.

"Don't talk nonsense, am I that kind of person?" Qiong Xiao defended embarrassedly.

"Eh... you're a typical wife-controller, but you're not that kind of person. I don't know about your frivolous nature?" Li Lang showed his disdainful eyes.

"Ahem! Let me see quickly, who are on this goddess list?" Being stared at by Li Lang with disdainful eyes, Qiong Xiao quickly changed the subject.

"Hey, I know you'll be eager to know what girls are up there, right?"

"Hey," Qiong Xiao scratched her head and said with a serious expression: "No, I just want to see how my beloved Xiang'er is evaluated here!"

"Uh..." Li Lang gave the scroll to Qiong Xiao. He was really convinced by Qiong Xiao!If you don't give him the scroll, sooner or later he will be pissed off by Qiong Xiao.

As the scroll was opened, a fragrance floated out of the scroll. This scroll was written by a girl!Qiong Xiao stared at Li Lang with an evil smile and said, "You are not generous enough. Just a few days after you came to Xingchen Academy, you hooked up with a girl and you didn't tell me!"

"Uh, you're talking nonsense, how did I hook up with a girl!" Li Lang shouted, and bubbles suddenly flew all over the sky.

Qiong Xiao tried her best to hide, and said quickly: "Ahem, don't get excited, talk about it properly!"

"Okay, I'll let you talk it over. If you don't tell me the reason today, see how I can punish you!"

"I have a basis for this, and I'm not just talking nonsense, okay! The scroll you just took exudes a kind of fragrance. It must be a girl's thing!" Qiong Xiao said, holding up the scroll.

Bang!Li Lang threw his head on the bed, "You, your kid said that I was hooking up with girls outside just because of this fragrance. How could I live in the same dormitory with an idiot like you!" Li Lang was shocked by Qiong Xiao's words.

"Uh... Then why does this scroll have a fragrance that only girls can have?" Qiong Xiao asked unwillingly.

"That scroll came from a girl group, and it was carefully made by them. How could it not have this fragrance?" Li Lang rolled his eyes and said.

"Okay! That's why I wrongly blamed you. If anything good happens in the future, just call me and feast your eyes on it!"

"Tch, you're not afraid of Senior Lan Xiang. I'm still afraid. If I take you to play, if she finds out, she'll beat me half to death! If you want to play, go by yourself," Li Lang said lightly.

"We are still not brothers!"
